title: 第15章 不识真龙第16章 象龙神拳
content_zh:
“十一王子，六公主，你们不觉得江若尘力量来得蹊跷吗？”
秦琪没有直接说出自己的看法，而是先问了江立六公主一个问题。
“当然蹊跷，这废物才觉醒了两天就进步如此飞速，简直不可能！”
江立等人毫无疑问的质疑了。
两天修出一象之力，不说他们身边，哪怕翻遍镇南王国的史书，都绝对找不出一例来。
“那不就是了？”
秦琪微微一笑，缓缓走到众人面前道：“大家都知道，这废物觉醒的是废武魂，别说这般神速了，恐怕是最基础的修炼都难以进行，而现在展现出惊人的一象之力。”
秦琪暂停，目光不屑的瞥了一眼还在擂台上的江若尘一眼后冷哼道：“我估计这份力量根本不属于他，是通过别的手段做到的！”
“别的手段……小琪你是指爆气丹？”
江立道。
秦琪笑着点头：“没错，就是爆气丹！
这种丹药虽然很珍贵，只有檀山剑庄能炼制，可你们别忘了，婉妃她……”
秦琪的话戛然而止，接下来像是会触碰到什么禁忌，再也未提。
江立六公主等人却是瞬间双眼一亮，瞬间领会了秦琪的意思！
同时也对秦琪的猜测高度认可！
是啊，一个废物怎么可能因为觉醒了废物武魂而翻身呢？
要知道，当初觉醒了七星武魂的三王子也未曾有这般速度，江若尘怎么可能做到！
除非他那烂泥鳅武魂脱胎换骨成龙魂，否则绝无可能！
“对，秦小姐分析得有道理，他一个废物，怎么可能进步如此迅速！
一定是服用了爆气丹！”

有大臣子嗣附和。
六公主冷笑一声也道：“小琪这么一说还真是，这个废物二重天可能是真的，但绝对不可能打通那么多暗脉，力量一定不属于他！”
“这个废物真是下贱，参加个武会还用不光彩手段，这要是传出去，我们王室的脸都要丢尽！”
江立佯装愤怒，心中实则乐开了花。
刚才江若尘展现出一牛之力时，他真被震撼了。
但听秦琪这么一分析，他释然了。
废物还是那个废物，只是没以前那么废了而已！
“不过话说回来，也是没想到他真能打通经脉开始修行，这件事我看还是有必要禀告王后娘娘！”
秦琪看向江立又道。
“嗯！
走吧，我这就进宫见母后！”
江立点头，一行人离开武会。
content_en:
"Eleventh Prince, Sixth Princess, don't you think Jiang Ruochen's power is strange?"
Qin Qi did not directly express her opinion, but first asked the sixth princess Jiang Li a question.
"Of course it's strange. This loser has only been awake for two days and has made such rapid progress. It's simply impossible!"
Jiang Li and others doubted it without a doubt.
It takes two days to cultivate the power of an elephant. Not to mention those around them, even if you look through the history books of the Zhennan Kingdom, you will never find a single example.
"Isn't that what it is?"
Qin Qi smiled slightly, walked slowly in front of everyone and said: "Everyone knows that this waste awakened the waste martial soul. Not to mention it is so fast, I am afraid that it is difficult to carry out the most basic cultivation, but now it has shown the astonishing power of one image."
Qin Qi paused, glanced disdainfully at Jiang Ruochen who was still on the ring, and then snorted: "I guess this power doesn't belong to him at all, it was achieved through other means!"
"Other means... Xiaoqi, you mean the Explosive Qi Pill?"
Jiang Lidao.
Qin Qi smiled and nodded: "Yes, it's the Explosive Qi Pill!
Although this kind of elixir is very precious and can only be refined by Tanshan Jianzhuang, don’t forget that Concubine Wan..."
Qin Qi's words stopped abruptly, and it seemed that she would touch some taboo next, but she never mentioned it again.
However, the Sixth Princess Jiang Li and others' eyes lit up instantly, and they instantly understood what Qin Qi meant!
At the same time, he also highly recognized Qin Qi’s guess!
Yes, how could a loser turn around because he awakened the waste martial soul?
You know, the third prince who had awakened the Seven-Star Martial Spirit had never been so fast. How could Jiang Ruochen do it!
Unless his loach martial soul is reborn into a dragon soul, it is absolutely impossible!
"Yes, Miss Qin's analysis makes sense. How could he, a loser, make such rapid progress!
He must have taken the Explosive Qi Pill! "
Some ministers and descendants agreed.
The Sixth Princess sneered and said: "What Xiaoqi said is true. This useless second-level heaven may be real, but it is absolutely impossible to open up so many dark veins. The power must not belong to him!"
"This good-for-nothing is really despicable. He used disgraceful means to participate in a martial arts competition. If word of this gets out, our royal family will be completely disgraced!"
Jiang Li pretended to be angry, but he was actually happy in his heart.
He was really shocked when Jiang Ruochen showed his strength just now.
But after hearing Qin Qi's analysis, he felt relieved.
The waste is still the same waste, just not as useless as before!
"But having said that, I didn't expect that he could really open up his meridians and start practicing. I think it is necessary to report this to the Queen!"
Qin Qi looked at Jiang Li and said.
"Hmm!
Let's go, I will go to the palace to see my mother! "
Jiang Li nodded and the group left the martial arts meeting.
